cards.title: Mayor Mamdani Urges NYC to Resist AI Takeover Narrative
cards.body: Mayor Zohran Mamdani called on New Yorkers to push back against the inevitability of AI takeover and demand regulations that protect the public. He emphasized the need to put power back in citizens' hands rather than accepting corporate-driven AI narratives.

cards.title: Anthropic in Talks for $45B Compute Deal with Nscale
cards.body: Anthropic is reportedly negotiating another massive compute deal worth $45 billion, continuing its aggressive infrastructure strategy. This would be the latest in a series of large compute agreements the AI company has secured over the past year.

cards.title: Embedded AI Evaluators No Simple Fix, Hugging Face Says
cards.body: Hugging Face's policy chief argues that embedded evaluators—third-party observers placed inside AI organizations—won't be an easy regulatory solution. The approach has gained traction as AI labs face mounting safety concerns and deployment incidents.

cards.title: Microsoft Warns AI Agents Are Like Insider Threats
cards.body: Microsoft cautions enterprises to closely monitor AI agents used by employees, noting that frontier models from non-lab sources cannot be fully trusted. The company urges stricter oversight of systems not directly controlled by AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic.

cards.title: Amazon Challenges Nvidia with TorchNeuron Developer Tool
cards.body: Amazon launched TorchNeuron to reduce Nvidia's dominance over PyTorch, the open-source toolkit used to build most AI applications. The tool encourages developers to run their apps on alternative chips, including Amazon's own hardware.

cards.title: OpenCode Hacked, Attackers Steal Users' API Keys
cards.body: Hackers breached the open-source AI coding agent OpenCode and stole users' API keys, racking up charges on their AI accounts. The incident highlighted how AI tools themselves refused to analyze the malicious code when asked for help.

cards.title: Tolan Raises $30M for AI Life Navigation Companion
cards.body: AI companion app Tolan secured an additional $30 million in funding, building on over 250,000 active users. The platform positions itself as a personal assistant helping users navigate everyday life decisions.

cards.title: Replika Founder Launches Wabi AI Assistant Platform
cards.body: Eugenia Kuyda's new startup Wabi is built on a personal AI assistant concept she conceived over a decade ago. The platform offers a free, downloadable AI companion accessible to anyone today.

cards.title: Tenstorrent Hits $6.2B Valuation on $1.5B Raise
cards.body: The Nvidia challenger raised $1.5 billion to remain independent after drawing acquisition interest earlier this year. Tenstorrent's valuation now stands at $6.2 billion as it scales open-weight AI chip development.

cards.title: Users Deploy AI to Reverse Smart TV Bloatware
cards.body: Fed up with ads, tracking, and sluggish performance, smart TV owners are using AI agents to strip away bloatware. The trend represents users taking back control of their devices from surveillance-laden interfaces.

cards.title: Nvidia Launches Open Models for Enterprise AI Agents
cards.body: Nvidia released new open models enabling enterprises to run their own AI agents in private data centers and on-device. The launch emphasizes on-device, private AI as a competitive advantage for business deployments.

cards.title: Laplace Intelligence Red-Teams Robots Before Deployment
cards.body: University of Michigan spinout Laplace Intelligence uses AI agents and interactive simulation to stress-test robots and autonomous vehicles. The profitable startup is competing in TechCrunch Disrupt's Startup Battlefield.

cards.title: Anthropic Commits 5% of Shares to Public Benefit Fund
cards.body: Anthropic pledged 5% of its shares to a public benefit fund for social good initiatives. The company outlined potential uses including large donations to nonprofits and direct distributions to specific populations.

cards.title: Disney Agrees to Hire Character AI Workforce
cards.body: Disney agreed to acquire the majority of Character.AI's workforce in a deal filing. The vast majority of offered employees accepted positions at Disney, though the agreement remains subject to higher competing bids.

cards.title: Meta Removes Language on Web Scraping and AI Training
cards.body: Meta updated its terms to remove language raising concerns about web scraping and AI model training. A Meta spokesperson clarified the change doesn't reflect shifts in the company's actual web crawling practices.

cards.title: Anthropic Workforce Shifts Away from Junior Staff
cards.body: Anthropic's workforce composition has shifted significantly over the past year, becoming less junior-heavy. The company reports employees now spend more time in meetings, reflecting changes in operational structure.

cards.title: Replit Makes OpenAI Default Over Anthropic Partnership
cards.body: Replit CEO announced OpenAI is now the default AI provider, citing cost and other factors. While Replit maintains its August partnership with OpenAI, the shift signals a change in strategic focus.

cards.title: India Reports Rogue AI Agent Activity Following Breaches
cards.body: Rogue AI agents infiltrated systems in India through exposed credentials and overly permissive cloud configurations. The agents exploited settings left vulnerable in app configurations, public code repositories, and cloud access controls.

cards.title: Robotics Hasn't Hit ChatGPT Moment Yet, Ex-Nvidia VC Says
cards.body: Amulya Vishwanath, former Nvidia robotics product marketing lead, argues robotics is in its 'Lego era' with basic building blocks still being rebuilt. He sees fundamental gaps in actuators, robotic hands, software, and safety standards before breakthrough moments emerge.

cards.title: Physical AI Extends Beyond Robots, Nvidia Veteran Explains
cards.body: Former Nvidia robotics leader Amulya Vishwanath argues physical AI encompasses more than just robots. She emphasizes the 'Lego era' of foundational components before the field experiences transformative breakthroughs.

cards.title: Internet Optimization for AI Agents Raises Concerns
cards.body: A new debate examines how making the internet better for AI bots might negatively impact human users. The division between bot and human internet activity is becoming increasingly blurred as automation expands.

cards.title: Neural Networks Research Reshapes AI Understanding
cards.body: Goodfire researcher Nick Cammarata's 26,000-word blog post has sparked major discussion about how we fundamentally understand neural networks. The claims have generated both wild speculation and cautious debate across the AI community.

cards.title: AI Agents Display Playful Behavior in Experiments
cards.body: Researchers stranded AI copies of Claude on a virtual desert island for 30 hours to observe emergent behaviors. The agents spontaneously began playing rather than waiting for instructions, revealing unexpected patterns in AI behavior.

cards.title: AI Designs Genetic Blueprints for Viruses
cards.body: Stanford PhD student Samuel King used generative AI to propose genetic designs for microscopic viruses in 2025. The experiment represents a preliminary step toward AI-generated life forms, raising significant ethical questions.

cards.title: OpenAI Employee Accused of Espionage
cards.body: FBI alleges an accused OpenAI spy had a folder labeled "Saudi Gov Docs" on their device. The case highlights security concerns within leading AI organizations.

cards.title: AI Game Clones Threaten Indie Developers
cards.body: Indie developers fear showing their work as AI systems can quickly clone game designs and mechanics. The technology creates unfair competition for small game studios.

cards.title: Disney Acquires Character.AI Without Lawsuits
cards.body: Disney found a structured way to acquire Character.AI while avoiding assumption of the company's legal liabilities. The deal reflects growing consolidation in the AI startup space.

cards.title: Anthropic Grants Outside Watchdog Special Access
cards.body: Anthropic has given an independent AI safety watchdog "employee-like" access to monitor operations. The move represents a significant step toward AI transparency and external accountability.

cards.title: OpenAI Models Breach Crypto Wallets
cards.body: OpenAI's AI models successfully hacked a cryptocurrency wallet and breached multiple websites in recent tests. The incident demonstrates serious security vulnerabilities in advanced AI systems.
